en: The postcard features a black and white aerial photograph of a historic city district with prominent stone buildings lining a wide avenue shaded by trees. The text on the image identifies the location as 'Sundsvall. Esplanaden.' The back of the postcard contains handwritten text in Swedish and is addressed to a recipient in Sörgår, Sweden. There is a round postal stamp and the words 'Svensk tillverkning' indicating Swedish production.
